🧾 Invoices & quotes (new Invoices tab):
• Make an invoice or a quote: customer, lines (scan a sticker or search Square to add items with their price), discount, shipping, sales tax per line, deposit, notes and terms
• Save & get the link: the customer opens it on the website, downloads the PDF, pays online with Square (Pay button) and accepts or declines a quote. Copy, email or text the link from the app
• Mark paid / part payments (cash, card, check, Venmo, PayPal, Zelle, store credit); online Square payments, opened links and quote answers come back by themselves
• PDF download, duplicate, quote → invoice, void (manager), overdue list and reminders, CSV for the books
• Draft → 🧾 Quote these cards: a quote to sell the ticked cards at sticker prices
